in_sanskrit.name: अह्लद
in_sanskrit.meaning: हद्द से अविर्भवित आनन्द, खुशियों से भरा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is filled with joy, bliss, or happiness that arises from within and is not dependent on external factors.

in_telugu.name: అహ్ళద్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is full of the brim with joy, bliss, or happiness.

in_marathi.name: Ahlad
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahlad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahlad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘ahlād’, meaning ‘happy’ or ‘blissful’. This name is rooted in Hindu mythology, where it is given to children born into families blessed with joy and prosperity. It is believed that the name Ahlad bestows happiness and contentment upon its bearer.
